notes: REF-BM-02: metadata capture collects title+favicon only; no description, no preview image (parse-metadata.ts returns only title+iconUrl). REF-BM-10: existing tags offered as a checkbox picker, not typeahead autocomplete on entry, and no inline tag creation. REF-BM-12: FTS index (bookmark-search-repository) covers title+url+tags but NOT notes; description not stored. REF-BM-14: no #tag syntax; query is escaped and wrapped as one FTS phrase. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised groups; whole query treated as a single quoted phrase. REF-BM-16: no user-controllable quoted-phrase exact match; everything is phrase-matched with no boolean mode. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later state at all; only an is_favorite flag exists (not read-state semantics). REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk-action endpoints/UI. REF-BM-23: notes stored and shown, but rendered as plain text (white-space:pre-wrap), no markdown parsing/library. REF-BM-24/25: no snapshot or PDF capture. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive state or archived-list view; delete is the only removal. REF-BM-29: folders are static single-assignment containers, not saved search+tag filters (bundles). REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no persisted user/display settings (sort is transient UI state; no font size or displayed-items setting).
